title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2024
part_text: ‘Notes that, despite the parliamentary recess due to the European elections, the Committee on Petitions expressed its position and made recommendations on important issues raised in petitions, including adopting two mission reports following fact-finding visits held in the second half of 2023, namely a mission to Ireland on mica buildings and a mission to Spain on linguistic immersion in Catalonia;’
